deploybot: [deploy] migration 'add_user_email_index' scheduled for 2026-06-05 03:00 UTC. Estimated exclusive lock on users ~8s during final swap. Holdpoint at step 2 (apply_swap). Manual approval required.

maria: Is this a global index? Any way to avoid a cluster-wide exclusive lock?

cheng: Yep global users table ~600M rows. We can't use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY because our PG version plus blackout requires offline locking for rename. Current play: copy to new_table in batches, sync with WAL, then rename. Final rename will need a brief exclusive lock.

sam: Could we instead do a tenant-by-tenant backfill and avoid a full rename? e.g., create index per-tenant range.

anya: Tenant-by-tenant is safer but slower. Rename approach reduces amount of repeated work. Need to validate FK constraints and TRIGGERS. Swap also requires brief exclusive lock on old table metadata.

opsbot: Replica lag: 12s (last 60m avg). Suggest rate_cap=200 rows/sec for copy, burst allowed to 400 for canary. Deploybot: adding manual holdpoint before apply_swap. Approve with :thumbsup: to continue.

maria: I'll approve if we add: 1) rate_cap=200; 2) canary tenant id=42; 3) query-level deadlock monitor; 4) rollback steps in runbook. tagging @oncall-ny

cheng: Added monitoring queries:
```
-- progress
SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE created_at < now() - interval '30 days' AND email IS NULL;
-- locks
SELECT pid, locktype, relation::regclass, granted FROM pg_locks pl JOIN pg_class c ON pl.relation = c.oid WHERE NOT pl.granted;
```
Rollback plan added: stop copy, drop new_table_partitions, revert traffic, notify.

sam: Runbook rollback commands:
- /deploy abort 2141598765
- psql -c "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS users_new_XXXX;"
- reconcile partial writes via shadow sync

anya: oncall-ny prefers conservative cap. I'll standby for canary. :eyes:

deploybot: Holdpoint reached. maria approved at 2141598790. Runner started canary tenant 42 with rate_cap=200. Logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/deploys/2141598765

cheng: Canary batch 1 finished, no lock spikes. avg time per chunk 1.2s. progressing to tenants 43-60.

sam: +1 from me. No deadlocks in trace. Proceed with tenant windows 61-200 in 10-min batches.

opsbot: Next checkpoint: replica lag under 30s, ok. Autoscaling triggers set at 75% CPU.

anya: quiesce window for final swap scheduled 03:15-03:25 UTC. We will set read-only for 30s during rename.

deploybot: Migration progressed to tenant 200. Final swap queued for 2141598820. Last monitoring snapshot: p95 latency +3ms, error rate unchanged.

maria: Approved final swap. Oncall-ny standing by.

deploybot: Final swap executed at 2141598822. Short exclusive lock observed: 7s. Swap complete. No rollbacks triggered.

cheng: Post-checks OK. Index present and used by planner on recent queries.

sam: Great. Closing runbook and adding notes to release. Thanks team :tada:

opsbot: Runbook updated: https://confluence.internal/redwood/runbooks/migrations/add_user_email_index
